question: Can the independent child consumer preserve a complete valid active negative that terminates after the kick but before resumed walking, while still rejecting missing or fabricated resume evidence in every other branch?

observed_fault.explanation: A complete precondition proves that the initial stand finished. It does not prove that post-kick recovery later reached walking resume. The collector requires both prefix and resume after any complete precondition, although the unchanged orchestrator can finish a valid failed terminal before resume exists.

terminal_source_retention.rule: Retain the actual pre-terminal orchestrator state, the actual event submitted to advance_v1, and its returned advance receipt when a terminal transition occurs. Publish the same source object with the final arm result. Do not rebuild these sources from the desired outcome.

independent_branch_proof.rule: Only an active behavior_negative child with a validated post-interaction failed terminal transition, exactly one complete prefix session and handoff, zero resume steps, and an empty resume session identity may use the one-session population. Validate the full transition and its enclosing source links before selecting that population.

required_zero_world_coverage: Reopen the exact no-resume diagnosis, its five frozen Git sources and its exact executable source bindings. Keep its original three diagnosed branches unchanged and recomputable.

Exercise the actual unchanged orchestrator and new production transition-retention projection on failed and refused prone confirmation, premature controller completion before prone confirmation, prone-confirmation timeout, failed and refused post-kick recovery, and post-kick recovery timeout.

Exercise the actual current child-data consumer end to end on each valid source-only no-resume negative, including exact terminal-transition, row, prefix, handoff, interaction and final-memory links. These synthetic fixtures are not physical results.
Retain complete two-session baseline, complete active positive, complete active walking-negative, and precondition-negative controls. Existing required populations remain exact.

Reject absent or partial terminal proof, stale and damaged digests, crossed identities, changed phase or reason, false or fractional host counters, wrong native memory number kinds, time gaps, false terminal success, nonterminal or wrong-role one-session claims, and mismatched source copies.

Reject a positive child with a missing resume, a negative child with hidden resume rows or a stray resume handoff, an incomplete prefix, wrong handoff order, missing interaction, and any failed engine-health or missing-peer acceptance attempt.

Verify the unchanged fixed thresholds and all 27 walking gate names, both original retained-segment v2 replays, invalid-evaluation retention, all L13 transport/ledger controls, L12 handoff controls, L11 release controls, L10 optional terminal strings and all earlier process-isolation controls.

Bind this addendum separately alongside the unchanged base L14 design in the supervisor, materializer, closer, qualification wrapper and complete prospective dependency closure. Exercise the actual production binding functions and wrapper before official qualification.
Every model, world, scene insertion, native physics readback, body write and solver-step count is zero.

authorization_boundary.next_physical_requirement: Complete new zero-world qualification of a clean pushed exact successor source, a separate smallest coverage-adequate development declaration, and a distinct committed prospective freeze/authority graph. This addendum creates no physical identity.
